AzureAd.Domain: use appsettings.Development.json [the domain of your tenant, e.g. contoso.onmicrosoft.com]
AzureAd.TenantId: use appsettings.Development.json [the tenant ID, a GUID]
AzureAd.ClientId: use appsettings.Development.json [the application (client) ID of the app registration]
AzureAd.ClientSecret: use appsettings.Development.json or user secrets [a client secret of the app registration]
